title: SREV-040 is box enabled sid string

audit_contract.description: API: Conf_Api_IsBoxEnabled / Api_CopySidStringFromUser | wire: {"request": "API_IS_BOX_ENABLED_ARGS", "fields": [{"name": "box_name", "type": "WCHAR*", "shape": "fixed local box name string"}, {"name": "sid_string", "type": "WCHAR*", "required": false, "shape": "NUL-terminated string SID within 94 WCHARs"}, {"name": "session_id", "type": "ULONG", "used_when": "sid_string is present"}]}

validation_invariants.description: All contracts listed in the contracts metadata must hold before any data is trusted past the validation boundary

runtime_matrix.description: Windows runtime gate proves contracts hold under normal and malformed inputs

contracts: optional sid_string is a user pointer and must be copied before Conf_IsBoxEnabled reads it
sid_string must be readable as 96 WCHARs with WCHAR alignment
sid_string must contain a NUL terminator before the local 94-WCHAR payload cap
local sid_string payload must start with S- before entering Conf_IsBoxEnabled
Conf_IsBoxEnabled receives only kernel-owned SID strings or Process_GetSidStringAndSessionId output
